content: Chikomiti cha kulolea ndela ja kwaakoma Ayesu
Ayesu pabhakajomola kulobhola genago goa, akaalobholelanga bhabhachijigana bhabhe,
“Mmanyanga kubhee pagapakupeta machobha gabhele kupakubhee na lichobha likolongwa lya Pasaka, na Amwana bha Amundu bhapakugalukwa ili bhabhambwe panchalaba.”
Gono muda Akaakung'i akolo na akanachilongola bha Bhayahudi bhakakongana pamo paluwani lwa nyuumba ja Akayafa jwaakibha Akung'i Amwenye.
Bhakakongolelana ndela ja kunkamula Ayesu kwa kuhiiya ili bhaakome.
Nambo bhakalobholanga, “Chikubho chenecho chikotokubhee mu lichobha likolongwa lya Pasaka, ili gukotokupetela ukomo nkati ja bhandu.”
Ayesu bhakuchulilwa mahuta kono ku Betania
Ayesu pabhakibha ku Betania, kaja kwa Asimoni, jwakibha na matana,
mwikege jumo jwakibha na chupa chichitwelile mahuta ga kunungila ga bei ngolongwa, bhakahika penipala Ayesu pabhatenda kulyee chakulya, bhakaakuchulila gena mahuta mmutwe.
Bhabhachijigana bhabhe pabhakabhona genago bhakachimwanga, bhakalobholanga, “Janiki achala jenjeni?
Kwa kubhee mahuta gangani nga ga bei ngolongwa, hikakombolike kuhuchwa na yene mbiha bhakaapekiinge akaahocho.”
Ayesu bhakagamanya chibhaganikia, bhakaalobholela, “Mboni ntendakunhabhuanga mwikege hojo? Jonojwe atekutenda chikubho chammbone.
Akaahocho mmi nabho machobha goa, nambo nenga mbakubheehopo pamo na mwangota machobha goa.
Hojo mwikege bhatekunguchulila mahuta gakunungila ili kumeka tayali kwa kunjika.
Nannobholelanga kweli, poa pala pachilambo pabhapakutangachiwanga jenje Ngani Jammbone, chikubho chaachitendite hojo mwikege chipakulongoleka kwa kwaakombokela bhenabho.”
Ayuda atendakoonda kwaagaluka Ayesu
Ngapena jumo jwa bhenibhala bhabhachijigana komi na bhabhele, bhakemitwa Ayuda Isikaliote, bhakajaula kwa Akung'i Akolo,
bhakaakonyanga, “Mpakumbee chilebhe niki handa mbakwaagaluka Ayesu kwaachinu?” Bhakaalangia hipande makomi gatatu ga maganga gagakemitwa mbiha.
Kubhoka penapo Ayuda bhakibha bhalolea ndela ja kwaagaluka Ayesu.
Ayesu bhalyee chakulya cha Pasaka pamo na bhabhachijigana bhabhe

Lichobha lya kujemeka tangu ja lichobha likolongwa lya mikate jangalekelwa chilongo, bhabhachijigana bhakaajendela Ayesu bhakaakonya, “Mpala tumpanganikie koji chakulya cha lichobha likolongwa lya Pasaka?”
Ayesu akaajangulanga, “Nnyaulange kunnyini kwa analome teno, mkaalobholele, ‘Bhannyigana bhalobhola, muda gwangu guikite, kwaachinu mbakulyee chakulya cha Pasaka pamo na bhabhachijigana bhangu.’”
Bhabhachijigana bhakatendanga handa Ayesu chibhakaalagia, bhakaapanganikia chakulya cha Pasaka.
Pajikahika kimuho Ayesu na bhabhachijigana bhabhe komi na bhabhele bhakatama kulyee chakulya.
Pabhatendita kulyee, Ayesu bhakalobhola, “Ndendakunnobholelanga kweli, jumo gwinu bhapakung'aluka.”
Bhabhachijigana ikaabhinanga muno mu mitima jabhenji, kila jumo akajemeka kwaakonya, “Hangwana! Bholi, nga nenga?”
Ayesu akajangula, “Jwapakutobhela mkate pamo na nenga mu libakuli nga jwapakung'aluka.
Amwana bha Amundu apakujomoka handa chigalobhola Majandiko ga Annoongo, nambo apakulaga mundu jola jwapakwaagaluka Amwana bha Amundu! Jikibha mbaya kwa mundu jonojwe handa akibha angabhelekwa.”
Ayuda, jonijola jwaagaluka, akaakonya, “Bhannyigana, bholi, nga nenga?” Ayesu bhakajangula, “Handa chinnongile,”
Chakulya cha Hangwana
Pabhatendita kulyee, Ayesu akatola nkate, akaachukulu Annoongo, akagumetula, akaapekea bhabhachijigana bhabhe abhikulobholo, “Ntolange nlyangange, gongo nga mmele gwangu.”
Ngapena bhakatola chikombe cha divai, bhakachukulu Annoongo, bhakaapekea bhabhachijigana babhe bhabhikulobhola, “Nng'wangange mwabhoa mu chikombe chenjeni.
Kwa maana jenje nga mihai jangu jijilangia lilagano, jijijitika ligongo lya bhandu bhajingi ili kwaabhokea mabohu.
Nambo ndendakunnobholela, ngang'wee kabhele divai mpaka lichobha lyela chimbakung'wee divai jiyono pamo na mwangota mu Umwenye gwa Atati bhangu.”
Na bhenaangota pabhakajomola kujemba, bhakajenda ku Litombi lya Mizeituni.
Ayesu bhatenda kulondola kubhee Apetulo bhapakwaakana

Penapo Ayesu bhakaalobholela, “Kilo cha leleni, mwangota mwabhoa mpakubhutuka na kuneka nenga, kwa kubhee jijaandikwe mu Majandiko ga Annoongo, ‘Mbakwapota anchugaji, na lilubhalo lya ngondolo lipakupwilingana.’
Nambo chimbakuyoka, mbakunlongolelanga chilambo cha ku Galilaya.”
Apetulo akaajangula Ayesu, “Hata handa bhoa bhapakubhee na lipamba na mwenga na kunneka, nenga nganneka ng'o.”
Ayesu bhakaalobholela Apetulo, “Kweli ndendakunnobholela, kilo chenjeni tangu likambaliko lyangajemba, mpakungana patatu.”
Nambo Apetulo akajangula, “Hata handa hipalikwa kujomoka pamo na mwenga, ngankana ng'o.” Na bhenibhala bhabhachijigana bhangi bhoa bhakalobholanga hela hela.
Ayesu aajopa Annoongo ku buchitani ja Getisemane
Ngapena Ayesu akajenda pamo na bhabhachijigana bhabhe mahali pakemitwa ku Getisemane, na jono akaalobholelanga, “Ntamange pambani na nenga nyaule penipala kwaajopa Annoongo.”
Bhakaatola Apetulo pamo na bhenibhala bhana bhabhele bha Azebedayo, na bhena bhakajemeka kuhechuka na kuumalika.
Penapo akaalobholelanga, “Ndenda kuhechuka muno muntima gwangu hata kubhandikila na kiujomoka. Mtamange pambani ntamange miho pamo na nenga.”
Bahi, akajaula nnoongi kachoko, akagwee manguku, akajopa, “Atati bhangu, handa ikombolike chikombe heche cha kulaga chimbete, nambo hikoto kubhee handa chimbala nenga, ila chimpala mwenga.”
Ngapena Ayesu akabhuja kwa bhabhachijigana bhabhe na kwaakolela bhatekugoloka. Akaakonya Apetulo, “Bholi, mwangota mwangacheanga pamo na nenga hata kwa lichaa limo?
Ncheange na mwajope Annoongo nkotokujingilanga mmalengelo. Mboomo jitenda kupala nambo mmele gwangamachili.”
Akajaula kabhele pabhele kwaajopa Annoongo, “Atati handa ikombolike chikombe heche cha kulagia chimbete ngoto kung'wela, bahi, upaliho gwinu gukweele.”
Pabhakabhuja kabhele, akaakolelanga bhagolwikinge, kwa kubhee miho gabhenji gakibha na lugono.
Ayesu akaalekanga akajaula kabhele patatu na kujopa abhi kulobhola malobhe galagala.

Ngapena bhakabhuja kwa bhabhachijigana bhabhe na kwaalobholela, “Bholi, tangu mgolwikinge na kupomolela? Nnolange muuda guhikite gwa Amwana bha Amundu bhapalikwa kulekelwa mmabhoko ga bhandu bhabhabhii na mabohu.
Nnyimukange, tujaulange. Atenda kuhika jonijola jwapakung'aluka!”
Kugalukwa na kamulikwa kwa Ayesu

Bahi, Ayesu pabhakibha tangu bhatenda kulongela nabho, popopo akahika Ayuda, jumo jwa bhabhachijigana komi na bhabhele. Pamo na bhenabho bhakahikanga bhandu bhajingi bhabhabhii na mapanga na himbonga bhabhatumwanga na Akaakung'i Akolo na akanahota.
Na jonojwe jwakapala kwaagaluka Ayesu, akibha atekwapekea hilolelo abhi kulobhola, “Amundu jonijola junapakunnamatila na kunchalimiaa nga jonojwe munkamulange.”
Bahi, Ayuda akajendelela Ayesu na kwalobholela, “Kunchelile bhannyigana!” Ngapena akaanyambatila.
Ayesu akaalobholela, “Aganja, ntende chintekuhika kutenda.” Penapo bhenibhala bhandu bhakahikanga, bhakaakamula Ayesu, bhakaalekelela mmachili.
“Jumo jwa jonijola jwakibha na Ayesu akagunyulula lubhoko lwabhe, akaguolomola upanga gwabhe, akaapota antumichi jwa Akaakung'i Akolo, akaaheketa lichikilo.
Ngapena Ayesu akaalobholela, mmujie upanga gwinu mu lihako lyakwe, maana joajola jwakoma kwa upanga, apakujomoka kwa upanga.
Bholi, nng'anikia ngakombola kwaajopa Atati bhangu anyangatile nabhena akanetela manyemba kupunda komi na bhabhele ga akaatumichi bhabhe bha kunani kulihunde?
Nambo bholi, Majandiko ga Annoongo gapakweela bholi gagalobhola, henela nga chiipalikwa kubhee?”

Muda gogogo Ayesu bhakagulobholela nkutuli gwa bhandu bhabhakahika kwaalekela mmachili, “Bholi, ntekuhikanga na mapanga na himbonga kuhika kungamula handa henela bhakupokanga bhandu? Machobha goa nakibha mu Nyuumba ja Annoongo kwaajigananga bhandu, mboni mwangakamulanga?
Nambo haga gangani goa gatekubhee, ili Majandiko ga akaalondoi bha Annoongo gakweele.” Ngapena bhabhachijigana bhoa bhakapwilinganika.
Ayesu bhatenda kwapeleka pa chebule
Bhandu bhenibhala bhabhakaakamula Ayesu bhakaapeleka ku nyuumba ja Akayafa, Akung'i akolo, pabhakakongananga na bhabhajigana Malagilo ga Amusa na akanahota.
Nambo Apetulo bhakaakagula kwa kutali mpaka kulugwani lwa Akaakung'i Amwenye. Bhakajingila nkati bhakatama pamo na akaalendei ili bhapate kulola chiipakubhee.
Bahi, Akaakung'i akolo na chebule joa bhakalolea malobhe ga unami nnani ja Ayesu ili bhapatange kwaakoma,
nambo bhangapatanga malobhe goagala ga kwakamulila Ayesu, hata handa bhandu bhajingi bhakahikanga bhabhakalobhola malobhe gajingi ga unami. Pakujomolekea kuhika bhakahikanga bhandu bhabhele,
na akalobhola, “Habha amundu bhakalobhola, ‘Ngombola kujibomola Nyuumba ja Annoongona na kujichenga kabhele kwa machobha gatatu.’”
Akung'i akolo akajema, akaakonya Ayesu, “Bholi, ngajangula lilobhe? Nga malobhe ga namuna niki habha bhandu bhagaleta nnani jinu?”
Nambo Ayesu akatama jii. Akaakung'i akolo akaalobholela, “Ndenda kunnapila kwa Annoongo bhabhii bhamomi, ntulobholele handa mwenga nga Akilisito Amwana bha Annoongo!”

Ayesu akaajangula, “Mwenga nnobhwile! Nambo ndendakunnobholelanga, kujemeka nangocheni mpakunnolanga Mwana jwa Amundu atamite upande gwa kunnelo jwa jonijola Hangwana jwabhii na machili, abhikuhika nnani ja mahunde ga kunani kwa Annoongo.”
Penapo Akung'i akolo akapapula ngobho yabhe, akalobhola, “Atendakwatukana Annoongo! Tupalahopo kabhele bhandu bha kongolela, nangocheni ntekunyoanikianga maligo gabhe.
Mwangota mmonanga bholi?” Bhenaangota bhakaajangulanga, “Jwatekulemwa apalikwa kujomoka.”
Ngapena bhakaahunila mata kumiho, bhakaapota mmajegwa. Bhangi kongo bhabhikwapota mmajegwa,
na kulobhola, “Ntulondolele, mwee Akilisito, nga aganiki bhabhampotite!”
Apetulo atenda kwaakana Ayesu
Apetulo akibha atamite panja palugwani. Bahi, antumichi jumo Ahikege bhakajendelela, bhakalobhola, “Mwenga nkibha pamo na Ayesu bha ku Galilaya.”
Nambo Apetulo akakana nnongi ja bhoa bhabhi kulobhola, “Ngachimanya chinlongela.”
Akabhoka penipala akajaula panniango, antumichi bhangi ahikege akaalola, bhakaalobholelanga bhandu bhabhakibha penapo, “Habha amundu bhakibha pamo na Ayesu Nnazaleti.”
Apetulo akakana kabhele kwa kulapila abhi kulobhola, “Ngaamanya abha amundu.”

Pagukapeta muuda kachoko, bhandu bhenibhala bhabhakibhanga bhajemite penipala bhakaajabhulila Apetulo bhakaalobholela, “Kweli mwenga nga jumo jwabhe, kwa kubhee namuna chinnongela ntenda kulandana na bhenaangota.”
Ngapena Apetulo bhakajemeka kuchilaani na kulapila abhi kulobhola, “Ngaamanya bhena amundu!” Popopo likambaliko likajemba.
Apetulo akakombokela malobhe gabhakalobholelwa na Ayesu, “Tangu likambaliko kujemba, mpakungana patatu.” Bahi, akabhoka panja, akaguta kwa hibhini.
